Check the [supported hardware](https://amigaux.org/hardware/) first. The disk controller the system
would be installed on decides the most. Fill in what you can; "don't know" is a fine answer.

**Machine**
Model and board revision (for example A2000 rev 6.2, A4000 rev B):

**CPU card**
Make and model, CPU and speed in MHz, MMU yes or no, firmware or ROM version:

**Memory**
Chip and fast RAM, how much, and on which card:

**Disk controllers**
Every one in the machine (onboard SCSI or IDE, SCSI on the CPU card, Zorro cards), and which one
would hold the system disk:

**Graphics**
Native, or an RTG card (which one):

**Network card**


**Kickstart version**
